defs.def: unpleasant to look at 丑陋的；难看的

ex.s: But why do we find some art beautiful and other art ugly?
ex.t: 但为什么我们发现有些艺术美丽而另一些艺术丑陋呢？

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 完美完好的食物被扔掉的数量令人震惊——从杂货商拒绝的"丑陋"（但完全可以食用）的蔬菜到大量被扔进餐厅垃圾桶的剩菜。

ex.s: And while plastic bags may be ugly to look at, they represent a small percentage of all garbage on the ground today.z.x.xk
ex.t: 而且尽管塑料袋看着可能丑，但它们只占如今地面所有垃圾的很小比例。z.x.xk

ex.s: Psychologist, Dr Hart Jade, 24, accounting manager As a song in Ugly Betty puts it, “It’s a pretty person’s world”.
ex.t: 心理学家哈特博士。杰德，24岁，会计经理。正如《丑女贝蒂》里的一首歌唱的，这是漂亮人的世界。

ex.s: Background information Ugly Betty is an American television series, originally broadcast on ABC from 2006 to 2010.
ex.t: 背景信息　《丑女贝蒂》是一部美国电视连续剧，最初于2006至2010年在ABC播出。

ex.s: I had seen him when he was unfinished – he was ugly then.
ex.t: 我见过他的时候，他还没有完成。 他当时很丑陋。

ex.s: Background information Hans Christian Andersen (1805–1875) was a Danish author who wrote some of literature’s best-loved fairy tales, including “The Emperor’s New Clothes”, “The Little Mermaid” and “The Ugly Duckling”.
ex.t: 背景资料汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安德森(1805年-1875年)是一位丹麦作家，他写了一些文学界最喜爱的童话，包括"皇帝的新衣","小美人鱼"和"丑鸭".

ex.s: They encounter numerous characters such as their departed grandparents, trees that hate mankind, the greedy and ugly Luxuries, and children waiting to be born.
ex.t: 他们遇到了无数的人物，比如他们已故的祖父母、憎恨人类的树、贪婪丑陋的奢侈享乐，以及等待出生的孩子们。
